profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Cast & Crew Entertainment Services
profile.summary:
A Microsoft Certified professional having 16+ years of Experience in Software Product Development with Microsoft .NET Technology stack.
8+ Years Experience as a Lead Software Engineer\Team Lead with Microsoft .NET Technology stack.
Strong Experience in C#,.NET Core, ASP.NET core, WEB API, MVC, Razor, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server.
Strong Experience in Client Side Technologies - JavaScript, jQuery, React, HTML , CSS, Bootstrap.
Strong Experience in Design & Development of RESTful Web API Libraries. 
Strong Experience in Product development lifecycle and SDLC. 
Experience in Cloud Service Development - Azure and AWS.
Experience of Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structure
Experienced in Design pattern, Development & Unit Testing, UML & OOAD Concepts.
Experience in Waterfall and Agile(Scrum) development Methodologies.
Experience in Agile Planning, Portfolio Management and ALM with Azure DevOps Server.
Experienced in CI\CD Pipelines and Release Management in Azure DevOps Server.
Experience in Server Side Programming, Distributed Systems, N-Tier & Microservice Architecture.

I also have experience working on Desktop applications using WPF, I have worked on 2 WPF projects using the MVVM pattern and CCF (Customer Care Framework).

As a Hobbyist/ Maker , I have started working on Internet of Things ( IoT) and have self learned - Microsoft IoT and Open Source Technologies – Like Python, Scratch. I have created small projects  on Hackster.io using Raspberry Pi , Arduino, Intel Edison and Particle IO .

I have been actively contributing / participating in Developer Forums / Communities - Stackoverflow / Codeproject / c-SharpCorner.

Contributed code and articles on Microsoft MSDN & Microsoft TechNet
Articles  on (http://code.msdn.microsoft.com). 
1. ASP.NET MVC and Bootstrap - with Demo code - 3000+ downloads 
2. ASP.NET MVC SSRS report - With demo code - 2000+ downloads
Microsoft TechNet. - 1. Visual Studio IDE: How to use surround with html tag

Recent Achievements: 
My Article got selected  as "Article of the Day" -  Microsoft ASP.NET Community
1. Title: Display SSRS Report In ASP.NET MVC Web Application : Dec 13, 2016
2. Title : ASP-NET-MVC-application-with-Custom-Bootstrap-Theme : Jan 12, 2017.

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Client: Wells Fargo
As a Senior Web Application Developer - I am part of the VSEM team and primarily responsible developing UI / writing code, testing ,writing SQL Queries & Stored procedure, designing SSRS Reports, code review and support to Client Team.  Technologies used: ASP.NET MVC 4.0 ,C#, JavaScript , jQuery, Kendo UI, SQL Server 2012, SSIS, SSRS, TFS, HP Quality Center and Bootstrap

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Client: Charles Schwab
As a Senior Software Engineer, I was part of the DOES Team and primarly responsible for migrating code from Coble.NET to C#.NET. • Was responsible for writing code for migrating third party legacy applications like ACAR, ALGO, Flex Service, AeroSpike, BlueSky, C11 into DOES using C#.NET. • Single handedly created a Rules Engine using C#, XML, LINQ and .NET Reflection to validate Trading Rules, Exchange Time validation Rules and Compliance Rules know as Edits in trading world ( As these keep on changing, so the plan was to implement decoupled approach for validating the Orders received before further processing). • Implemented Async Task functionality for each of the third party legacy application asynchronous calls, also implemented the existing Error logging and Message logging framework for the new DOES system. • Implemented Unit Testing Framework – Microsoft Fakes - for writing test cases and then writing code for the desired functionality. (used the TDD approach) • Used TFS for configuration management, version control and Build automation and Task management. • Involved in Defect Triage and defect fixing during QA testing.

projects.title: VSEM - Wells Fargo  Charlotte, NC
projects.description:
Roles and Responsibilites:
• Creating / developing Search functionality for Cluster Test Unit: Build front-to- back functionality, creating the business objects (model), Controller, Views using C#, ASP.NET MVC, Kendo UI & SQL Stored Procedures.
• Creating / developing functionality for components Projects & Campus: Build front-to- back functionality, for creating View, Controller, Business Objects using C# and ASP.NET MVC, Kendo UI and stored procedures 
• Implementing Kendo UI Grid functionality for components - Campus, Project and Search results in search pages UI.
• Designing and developing Error page functionality to log the Error in text file and display the error messages and error stack on the custom Error page.
• Designing and developing functionality to automatically send email containing details of the Error (stack trace and error message) to the operations team, when and error occurs. 
• Writing complex stored procedures to generate SSRS reports. (SQL Server Reporting Services). 
• Using Visual Studio Unit Testing Framework – wrote test methods for testing the project code.
• Troubleshooting and resolving performance issues of SQL Queries / stored procedures using Execution Plan and SQL Profiler 
• Analyzing and defect fixing for the defects logged in HP Quality center 

Additional Responsibility:
• Provide support to business team with queries and adhoc support during testing for the application.
• Worked with BA / Testers to ensure requirements & functionality are correct and translated accurately into technical code. 
• Created a POC of the VSEM application using Bootstrap 3.0 and presented a DEMO to the Business Stack holders, migrated all the UI (Views) of the application to Bootstrap 3.0 and Kendo UI bootstrap. 
• Responsible for peer code reviews as reviewer and reviewee
